about.en: PDD Holdings bStock (PDDB) is a tokenized share of PDD Holdings Inc. issued by BTECH Holdings Ltd, a special purpose vehicle registered in the Abu Dhabi Global Market (ADGM), under Binance's bStocks brand. It is a BEP-20 token on BNB Chain at 0x95b0409679b55c31772daa2fb4bee7b125b77521, backed 1:1 by PDD shares and convertible 1:1 with the underlying equity, with stock splits and dividend adjustments processed by the issuer. bStocks are offered under an ADGM-approved prospectus and not in other jurisdictions.
